svg.text: CONCEPT STUDY - PROVISIONAL DIMENSIONS - DO NOT BUILD WITHOUT REVIEW
1. Dimensions in mm. Third-angle projection. General tolerances to be defined (ISO 2768-m proposed).
2. Board outlines: maker or distributor data cited in hardware/netlist.json; others are indicative envelopes.
3. Heights, connectors and positions of openings are indicative and must be measured on the chosen parts.
4. Geometry and sheets generated by cad/generate.py (build123d 0.13.0); checks run with --check.
Redline tracker and black box, board RL-MB-01 (nRF9151)
EXPLODED ISOMETRIC / 25 CALLOUTS / SCREW AXES IN CHAIN LINE / W1 BATTERY CABLE IN RED
U1 nRF9151 SiP: LTE-M, NB-IoT, NTN, DECT NR+, GNSS
U4 nPM1300 PMIC: charger, fuel gauge, regulators
U5 64 Mbit low-power flash: the black box memory
U7 Hold-up charger and ideal diode for C1
J1 USB-C receptacle (charge and black box readout)
SW1 Side button: arm, disarm, pair
PL1 Tamper plunger, 4 mm, spring loaded
Sources: hardware/netlist.json. 'indicative': size to be taken from the part chosen.
- 92 x 62 x 22 mm (112 mm with the strap ears)
- Cellular, satellite and DECT NR+ mesh from one SiP
- Shock +-200 g, motion, tamper plunger, black box flash
- Hold-up capacitor for the last message
